title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival! — Episode8 On a Cobblestone Path

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Event Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Line: Summer Festival Fairgrounds

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That was way too much fun!
I know it's supposed to be the amateur division, but everyone was so good! Li'l Bro and Toya were amazing too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, this is my first time seeing him perform, but I guess he did okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I had fun too.
Music feels so much more powerful when you get to hear it live...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was so loud. My ears have been ringing for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think so. I'm sure it'll get better if I just wait.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You sure? Just make sure to take it easy when you get home, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for coming today, everyone. I never would've come to something like this alone and I think I learned a lot from it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Great! I had a lot of fun too! I'm glad we could go out together like this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So what do you wanna do after this? I kinda want to check out the rest of the festival.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd like that too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think I'll go home.
I should write down the ideas that this event gave me before I forget.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going home too. My mom might start worrying if I don't soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sounds good...
I was hoping to hang out a little more, but that's okay. See you on Nightcord!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Bye, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is there somewhere in particular you want to go, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Cotton candy sounds really good right now. I saw these really pink ones earlier!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, hey. That was a good concert. Your performance had the crowd going nuts back there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and thanks for earlier.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm glad they helped.
You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're here. I'm glad I found you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, I didn't know you came too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, you too?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't know you were both here. Did you skip practice today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, we had practice like normal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we ran into Akito and his friend, so we decided to stick around and see him perform!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, they both did so well.
It was a wonderful performance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ew, creep...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You two really never change, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, since we're all here, wanna check out the rest of the festival together?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, but what about the rest of you guys...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to as well. It'd be nice to go as a group.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were planning to take a look at some stalls with another friend of ours, but we can go if it's just for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, what are you dragging me into?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They went out of their way to invite us. It'd be rude for us to decline.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How about you, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm in too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then off we go.
You too, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: H-Hey...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Man, I'm getting pretty hungry.
I should probably get something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, they're selling honeycomb toffees over there. They look very appetizing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They do look good, but I was thinking about getting some real food, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd like to get something to eat too. Yakisoba or kushiyaki would be perfect!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len, you're clear to come out now. What do you wanna get Rin and the others?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Okay!
Oh, how about those caramel apples?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sure, let's go get some.
Is there anything you'd personally like, Len?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? How did we end up next to each other...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't ask me. I'd rather be talking to Airi and everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if we walk all spread out, we'd just end up being a huge roadblock. That's how I ended up next to you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, geez, I get it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And did you remember to talk to the committee people about what happened to your shoes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I never thought that they'd mistake it for their equipment. I mean, they could've at least checked what was inside first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Apparently, they mistook it for a box of extension cords. At least they found their way back to you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
Didn't you bring me my shoes the last time we were here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So you still remember...
I thought you'd long since forgotten about that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Of course I remember.
How can I forget about what happened with my sandals that time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I'll never forget about how I had to treat you like a princess.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that's not fair! I thanked you afterward, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, but you conveniently forgot that part? I still remember how I put on my sneakers and went to see the concert with you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
To think that I'd end up performing on the same stage years later...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You'd just quit playing soccer too. It was like you thought the world just ended.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Can you at least forget that part?
I'm over that and doing this now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it is cool how you've stuck with singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You were the reason I started singing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Did you say something? I couldn't really hear you over all these people...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You guys!
After we eat, wanna try our hand at some ring tossing?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we can split into teams since there's so many of us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nah, I'm good. I've gotta go soon.
That includes you too, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see some interesting prizes at the ring toss stall. Just one try, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, did you forget about what we discussed with Len...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course I didn't. We're going to find the best prize and try to get it for him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, not that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With Ena and Akito, we'd have even teams of three.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, we can have a battle of the Shinonomes with Team Ena and Team Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Akiyama, what are you doing...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Chill, it'll be fun♪
Let's make the most of it since we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we never do anything like this. How about the loser has to buy pancakes for the winner?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? I said I'm not playing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean you think you're gonna lose?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it doesn't.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then let's go.
We're keeping everyone waiting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, fine, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess she did save me back there. Maybe I owe her this much...)
